author: Subscriptor
body:
hey guys, ive recently left my team (fortissimus) becuase it didn't fit my needs.
I'm looking for a serious team that is competitive, as well having fun. i have past experience in around 16 avicus teams (no joke lmao).
I have 2 years experience in avicus and i have knowledge in all maps, i can ninja bridge, shift unshift staircase, i can cannon, ive also been playing ocn for a year but not that regulary as avicus, im also playing kohi regulary. i can play pretty much every position but prefer offense, i play like to play in a team and i listen to commands given, im 13 years old and my timezone is GMT +2:00. im avalibale all days of the week, but sometimes i cant get on cuz school. i have a mic and i speak fluent english.
cons: ping sometimes (lagging), sometimes being really angry XD but i calm down after, and not god at bow.
skype: ERIC_MCgamer

thanks ;D
